text:
emily_marketing: quick heads-up — we need a compact ops plan for the webinar launch posts. core asks: messaging heatmap, anchor/internal-linking changes, and redirect rules. timeline: finalize by Tue EOD so engineering can schedule the redirect sweep on Wed morning.

jordan_seo: +1. i'll draft keyword clusters and the canonical mapping today. can we limit scope to 6 priority pages?

emily_marketing: yes please keep it tight — hero blog, webinar landing, three pillar posts, thank-you/gtm page.

maria_prod: for messaging iteration, do we have the final value props from the comms doc? last I saw there were two variants. which one should go in meta descriptions?

aj_growth: we tested the two CTAs in the beta campaign — CTA B had 18% higher CTR on cold audiences. I'd recommend CTA B in page H1/CTAs, and CTA A for remarketing content.

jordan_seo: noted. i'll wire CTA B into meta titles/descriptions for the priority pages. i'll also output a short redirect map for any URL changes.

sam_eng: heads-up — redirect sweep window is 04:00-06:00 UTC Wed. during the window we'll push 302s then swap to 301s after validation. sync with SRE?

emily_marketing: yes, sam, SRE is on standby. we'll aim to have all mapping in the spec by Tue 17:00 to allow staging QA.

jordan_seo: here's a minimal redirect snippet i'll propose (we'll attach the full CSV to the ticket):

```
# old_path,new_path,type,reason
/webinar-old, /webinar, 301, consolidate landing
/blog/product-launch-1, /blog/launch-post-hero, 301, canonicalize pillar
/thanks-old, /thanks, 302, temp UTM backfill -> change to 301 after QA
```

jordan_seo: also recommending schema tweaks: add Webinar schema on the landing (startDate, organizer), and enhance BlogPosting with primaryImage and mainEntityOfPage. will paste JSON-LD tomorrow.

maria_prod: for internal linking/anchor heatmap — can we add deep links from the hero blog to two pillar posts (in-body) and from webinar page to the lead magnet (right rail)? keeps link equity focused.

aj_growth: agree — also add UTM templates for inbound routing: utm_source=webinar_email, utm_medium=cta, utm_campaign=mar23_launch. that helps routing in HubSpot.

sam_eng: one more technical note: when we flip 301s, we'll also add Link HTTP header for rel=canonical on duplicate paths to speed up crawlers. low-risk.

emily_marketing: perfect. here's the action list: Jordan — deliver keyword clusters, redirect CSV, and JSON-LD schema by Tue 12:00. Maria — finalize anchor placements and CTA copy by Tue 14:00. Aj — confirm UTM templates and messaging heatmap summary by Tue 15:00. Sam — schedule redirect job and SRE handoff, confirm Wed 04:00-06:00 UTC. ops-bot: create ticket and remind assignees on Tue morning.

ops-bot: Ticket created: #MK-2345 "Webinar launch: redirects + schema + anchors" — assignees: jordan_seo, maria_prod, aj_growth, sam_eng. Reminder scheduled for 2024-03-18T09:00:00Z. :white_check_mark:

emily_marketing: thanks team — i'll run one last preflight on Tue after deliverables land. :rocket:
